sequence: Valid scripted investigation, one rejected unknown handle, then otherwise valid patch.
cause: Native guard compares count of all queried handles, including rejected ones, with issued-handle count. A rejected query can permanently prevent otherwise valid repair.
native_scope: No native patch followed the serial rejected queries; this latent guard defect was not the directly observed native exception.
recommended_check: Compare issued-handle set with queried issued handles, and verify rejected handles neither satisfy nor poison coverage.
